timing_gate.rule: 2/3 baseline; noisy cells extend to 5, then at most 7. At n>=5 require mean CI95 half-width <=2% and early/late mean drift <=5%. No sample deletion.

causal_conclusion: Not established: identical logical/copy work excludes workload-count changes, but does not distinguish CPU scheduling, staging latency, NCCL waits, thermal or clock variation during the measured interval. Boundary snapshots are not continuous telemetry. No samples excluded.
